llm_response.reason: Multiple indicators confirm scam activity: (1) repeated external complaints about missing products and ignored customer service inquiries; (2) explicit claims across trusted social and review platforms that this site is fraudulent; (3) absence of legitimate business/legal/contact information on-site; (4) navigation restricted to shopping/cart, with no verifiable credentials or company transparency; these all strongly correspond to the characteristics of a scam e-commerce website attempting to defraud customers, mainly through fake online shopping practices.
